absences.statement: There are no statewide measures on Maine’s November 3, 2026 ballot. The complete official state and municipal sample-ballot set contains candidate contests only.

provenance.sourceOrg: Maine Secretary of State; Town of Brunswick Clerk

coverageNotes: The official FINAL general candidate spreadsheet includes primary winners and non-party candidates. The September 22 withdrawals and replacements document confirms the current requested nominees. Ten declared write-in candidates for these contests are included from the separate official August 25 list.

The Secretary of State’s July 10, 2026 statement and Maine Supreme Judicial Court decision 2026 ME 59 confirm that An Act to Designate School Sports Participation and Facilities by Sex did not qualify for the ballot. The current official initiative inventory lists that petition and two other proposals approved for circulation; those proposals are not certified November measures.

Maine has no statewide measures on the November 3, 2026 ballot. The complete official sample-ballot set published by Brunswick covers state ballot styles 70, 71 and 72 and every municipal district 1–7: all six documents, nine pages including both sides of every state ballot, contain only candidate contests. Title 21-A section 603 requires official samples to be substantially the same as regular ballots; section 906 permits state referendum questions on state or municipal ballots, and both complete sets were inspected.
